__comment: Base crossed-squares model for chandeliers. Matches 1.7.10 render type 1 (RenderBlocks.renderCrossedSquares), which draws two 45-degree planes spanning 0.05..0.95 of the block -- 0.9 blocks wide -- over the FULL block height. Vanilla block/cross is the same geometry but adds rescale:true, which stretches the planes out to the full diagonal and renders ~11% larger; omitting it is what makes this match the original. The fixture appears to hang because the texture's bottom three rows are transparent, not because the quads are offset.
